summary: Jasper Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq notice of non-compliance with the minimum stockholders' equity requirement of $2.5 million, per Listing Rule 5550(b)(1). The company has 45 days, until October 5, 2026, to submit a compliance plan. It intends to regain compliance through stockholder approval of converting non-voting convertible preferred stock, to be sought at a special meeting. If the plan is accepted, it may receive up to a 180-day extension; otherwise, a hearing before the Nasdaq Hearing Panel could stay any suspension. Watch for Nasdaq's acceptance of the compliance plan and stockholder approval timing.
